title: Dhalti Shaam
prompt: Hindi lo-fi indie-fusion with mellow tabla groove, warm Rhodes piano, fingerpicked acoustic guitar and round sub bass, nostalgic and tender, vinyl-warm low-fidelity production, soft intimate male vocals with airy double-tracked harmonies, hazy analog timbre
lyrics:
[Intro]
[melancholic]
(humming soft)

[Verse]
Dhalti shaam ki gali mein
Teri yaadein ghar bana gayi
Chai ka dhuaan, purani baat
Dil ke kone tak sama gayi

[Pre-Chorus]
Dheere dheere sab badal gaya
Par tu wahi, tu wahi raha

[Chorus]
[harmonies]
Yaadon ki lo-fi dhun baja
Tu meri shaam ka ujala
Khoya sa main, tujhe dhoondta
Tu hi mera ghar, tu hi rasta

[Verse 2]
Khidki se aati thandi hawa
Tere naam ki khushboo liye
Purana gaana, dheema sa
Aankhon mein sapne so gaye

[Pre-Chorus]
Dheere dheere sab badal gaya
Par tu wahi, tu wahi raha

[Chorus]
[harmonies]
Yaadon ki lo-fi dhun baja
Tu meri shaam ka ujala
Khoya sa main, tujhe dhoondta
Tu hi mera ghar, tu hi rasta

[Bridge]
[Guitar Solo]
Waqt ki dhool mein
Tasveer dhundli si
Par dil abhi bhi
Tujhe hi dhadakta

[Outro]
(tu hi rasta...)
Dheere se kho gaya
